origins.neoorigins.wraith.name: Ngā Wraith
origins.neoorigins.wraith.description: He wairua mamae e rere ana i roto i te take mārō. Ka haere ia i roto i te nuinga o ngā poraka, engari kāore e taea te haere i te obsidian kia tae ra ano ki tōna āhua tihi. Ko te pupuri i te āhua ōkiko e whakakore ana i te hiakai, ā, ka tahuna e te rā tōna kikokiko.
power.neoorigins.wraith_phase.name: Te āhua āhuahira
power.neoorigins.wraith_phase.descriptio: Whakawhiti: haere i roto i ngā poraka mārō. I a koe e noho ana i roto i tētahi poraka, rere noa atu (whakatere = ki runga, neke = ki raro). Obsidian, te tangi obsidian, me te papa pūtake e aukati i tō huarahi. Ka whakawātea e te whakawātea te hiakai.
Kāore e hiahiatia e ia te manawa. Ka taea te ora i raro i te wai.
Ka tahuna koe i te rā tika.
